preservation: Earlier raw attempts remain in this directory; only selected final gates count as current passing results.

repairs.finding: Repeated connection calls and concurrent TCP/QUIC dialing could stall qualification or route RPC over an unexpected connection.
repairs.repair: Batch identity-pinned addresses, use DisconnectedAndNotDialing and retain address fallback to that same peer; bind RPC protocol and RTT to the actual connection ID.
repairs.regression: Repeated discovery/jobs under TCP, QUIC and BOTH; wrong-first-address fallback cannot change the confirmed identity.

repairs.finding: After a rapid QUIC executor restart, a stale UDP session could make a job wait fail before reconnecting.
repairs.repair: Bound the peer-job deadline and disconnect that stale pinned session only on deadline. Explicit retries retain the original ID, manifest and executor.
repairs.remaining_behavior: A first transport deadline remains possible and is preserved in bounded_reconnection_observations. At most three test-controlled retries require the original receipt or signed expected refusal and no additional provider effect.

repairs.finding: The stock JSON frame reader could accept a valid prefix followed by padding beyond its configured byte cap.
repairs.repair: Read cap plus one byte and reject oversize before parsing; bound outgoing bytes without changing protocol-1 JSON/EOF semantics.
repairs.regression: Exact limit, oversized padded valid JSON and oversized writes.

repairs.finding: Qualification messaging against an offline peer could consume an excessive transport wait.
repairs.repair: Use a separate five-second diagnostic wait and record messaging FAIL.
repairs.regression: Offline messaging qualification completes within the bounded command budget.

repairs.finding: Migration review found that an existing foreign database owner should be refused before backup or schema DDL.
repairs.repair: Check persisted ownership before creating the migration backup; preserve schema/identity on refusal.
repairs.regression: Wrong-owner schema-1 state fails without backup creation; backup collision and unsupported future schemas also fail closed.

repairs.finding: The original peer harness still wrote candidate 0.1.0 into an otherwise current successful receipt.
repairs.repair: Read the candidate version from workspace Cargo metadata and rerun all 33 peer checks.

repairs.finding: Windows-generated package manifests could use backslashes unlike canonical ZIP entries.
repairs.repair: Use as_posix for manifest and ZIP relative paths; native package tests still remain required on Windows.

repairs.finding: Fresh extracted package version check found that porch --version exposed the internal porch-cli crate name.
repairs.repair: Set the explicit Clap command name to porch without relaxing the package assertion.
repairs.regression: Packaged CLI must report porch 0.1.1; original eight CLI assertions and platform command contracts rerun.

environment_failures.finding: Cached Cargo test artifacts included a non-executable recovery binary.
environment_failures.resolution: Clean the affected package artifacts and rebuild; final rust-release-gate.log executes all 29 tests. This is not classified as a product recovery failure.

environment_failures.finding: Standard Playwright Chromium archive installation failed.
environment_failures.resolution: Use a separately installed compatible Chromium 153.0.8010.0 via PORCH_BROWSER_PATH; successful UI evidence is ui-complete.log. No browser runtime dependency is added to the product.

external_failures_not_executed: Live Ollama process stop with actual weights
